newsitem.title: UK: UK pyhsical grains steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: UK pyhsical grains steady in quiet market.

text.p: UK physical grain prices were firm on Wednesday, but trade was sluggish.
"By all the normal rules the market should be down with demand this thin," said a trader.
Others said the market was jittery, mainly on currency, and uncertain over it's future direction.
"Currency is playing its part, but people are nervous because they cannot see where we go from here," said another trader.
No business was reported on the fob market where feed wheat was offered for March at 95.50 stg with a bid at 95 stg and May at 97.75 stg with a buyer at 97.25 stg.
Delivered prices were around one to two stg up on a thinly traded market.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 115 stg for May in the Southampton, Tewkesbury, Avonmouth and Gloucester range.
In the middle of the country Feb feed wheat traded at 91.75 stg while 94.50 stg was paid in East Anglia.
Feed barley traded at 96 stg for Feb in East Anglia and 97 stg for Mar.
On the south coast 97.50 stg was paid for Jan and 98 stg for Feb.
